newsitem.title: UK: Boots may consider financial services move.
newsitem.headline: Boots may consider financial services move.

text.p: Boots Co Plc said on Wednesday it would look at expanding into new areas using information obtained from its new Advantage loyalty card, including credit card facilities.
Steve Russell, managing director of Boots The Chemists, was asked at a news conference whether Boots would consider moving into banking like other major UK retailers.
He said banking was unlikely, but the company might perhaps consider credit card facilities.
Major food retailers and Marks and Spencer Plc now offer financial services along with their mainstream retail businesses.
Russell said Boots would use data obtained via the loyalty card, available from September 1, mainly to drive Boots The Chemists existing ranges.
He said Boots hoped the card would increase market size for some products and boost the group's market share.
Steve Hill, director of Boots' beauty business, said trials of the card had resulted in extra sales and brand loyalty.
Boots is investing 52 million stg in the card over three years, but expects it to break even this year, stripping out capital and set up costs.
